title: Stop Drowning in Deadlines: 5 Time Management Tips for Freelancers
subtitle: Reclaim your hours, boost your income, and find work-life balance without the burnout.

chapters.title: The Freelancer's Survival Guide: 5 Tips to Take Back Your Time
chapters.summary: A comprehensive walkthrough of five essential time management strategies for freelancers, including task batching, setting ironclad boundaries, prioritizing high-value work, automating repetitive tasks, and scheduling intentional rest to maximize productivity and prevent burnout.
